periods.analysis: We held 6 community screening events in Q1 at library branches and the Community Health Center.
periods.recommendations: Bring blood pressure checks to faith partner sites.

periods.analysis: Events grew from 6 to 11, including blood pressure checks at four congregations.
periods.recommendations: Add diabetes screening at the Bayfront farmers market.

periods.analysis: Sixteen events ran in Q3, adding blood pressure checks at faith partner sites and diabetes screening at the Bayfront farmers market.
periods.recommendations: Pair events with colorectal screening kit handouts and track follow-up visits.
